stories.title: Gold Twirl bar winner mulls giving auction a whirl
stories.summary: Sean O' Brien, from Coventry, won the 18-carat gold-plated chocolate bar replica in a competition.

stories.title: Hotel to stop housing asylum seekers
stories.summary: The Days Hotel has been used to accommodate asylum seekers since January 2023.

stories.title: Body still missing after four convictions
stories.summary: Ben Whyley, Junior Makosso, Sam Jones and Thomas Young are due to be sentenced on 1 December.

stories.title: A45 to close in December for HS2 works
stories.summary: The A45 Coventry Road will shut in both directions near Bickenhill, Solihull.

stories.title: Attorney general reviewing sentence of boy's killer
stories.summary: Driver Aleksanders Dolars was jailed for nine years four months for killing Keaton Slater, 12, in a crash.

stories.title: Hundreds could be hit by chemotherapy scandal, trust says
stories.summary: Becky Jones says chemotherapy had been "dished out like it was sweets" to patients like her.

stories.title: Jury discharged in trial over baby's death
stories.summary: The pair are due to face a retrial in connection with the death of the one-year-old girl, in 2025.

stories.title: 'Bonkers' Shakespeare Institute move must end, says actor
stories.summary: Samuel West is spearheading a petition against the move with more than 16,000 signatures.

stories.title: New £14m air ambulance base for Warwickshire approved
stories.summary: The Air Ambulance Service charity said the new Catthorpe site was urgently needed.

stories.title: Deaf sports award nomination 'shows no limit to what I can achieve'
stories.summary: Charlotte Gower is "honoured" to be nominated for Deaf Sports Personality of the Year award.

stories.title: Asylum hotel to close within weeks
stories.summary: Warwick's Delta Hotel will close as a asylum seeker accomodation early next year, Matt Western says.

stories.title: Gnomes stolen from charity fundraising display
stories.summary: Police are investigating after about 30 of the ornaments were taken from a couple's Coventry garden.
